GENERAL SCIENCE — TERMLY EXAM #1
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: GENERAL SCIENCE
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 50 °C
   B. 100 °C
   C. 0 °C
   D. 37 °C

2. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. Any white crystal used in cooking
   B. A mixture of two liquids
   C. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means
   D. Any substance that conducts electricity

3. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Nutrition in Animals ● Chemical and mechanical digestion of foods ● Adaptations ? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Nutrition in Animals ● Chemical and mechanical digestion of foods ● Adaptations .
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Nutrition in Animals ● Chemical and mechanical digestion of foods ● Adaptations .
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Nutrition in Animals ● Chemical and mechanical digestion of foods ● Adaptations .
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Nutrition in Animals ● Chemical and mechanical digestion of foods ● Adaptations .

4. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. joule (J)
   B. watt (W)
   C. pascal (Pa)
   D. newton (N)

5. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Introduction to General Science ● Importance of General Science, ● Careers in Ge? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Introduction to General Science ● Importance of General Science, ● Careers in Ge.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Introduction to General Science ● Importance of General Science, ● Careers in Ge.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Introduction to General Science ● Importance of General Science, ● Careers in Ge.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Introduction to General Science ● Importance of General Science, ● Careers in Ge.

6. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. A chemical reaction forming ash
   B. Movement of water only across a membrane
   C. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration
   D. Heating until a solid melts

7. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Plant Growth and Development 1.7 Microorganisms 2.0 Matter and Chemical Reaction? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Plant Growth and Development 1.7 Microorganisms 2.0 Matter and Chemical Reaction.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Plant Growth and Development 1.7 Microorganisms 2.0 Matter and Chemical Reaction.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Plant Growth and Development 1.7 Microorganisms 2.0 Matter and Chemical Reaction.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Plant Growth and Development 1.7 Microorganisms 2.0 Matter and Chemical Reaction.

8. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes
   B. Burning crop residue every week
   C. Overgrazing continuously
   D. Removing all vegetation

9. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Microorganisms ● Types of microorganisms ● Mode of transmission and infections o? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Microorganisms ● Types of microorganisms ● Mode of transmission and infections o.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Microorganisms ● Types of microorganisms ● Mode of transmission and infections o.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Microorganisms ● Types of microorganisms ● Mode of transmission and infections o.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Microorganisms ● Types of microorganisms ● Mode of transmission and infections o.

10. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. A compound can be separated by filtering only
   B. A mixture always has a fixed melting point
   C. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio
   D. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya

11. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Chemical Families ● Alkali metals, alkaline earth metals, halogens, noble gases ? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Chemical Families ● Alkali metals, alkaline earth metals, halogens, noble gases .
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Chemical Families ● Alkali metals, alkaline earth metals, halogens, noble gases .
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Chemical Families ● Alkali metals, alkaline earth metals, halogens, noble gases .
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Chemical Families ● Alkali metals, alkaline earth metals, halogens, noble gases .

12. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Glucose and oxygen
   B. Only water vapour
   C. Only carbon dioxide
   D. Nitrogen gas only

13. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Microorganisms 2.0 Matter and Chemical Reactions 2.1 The Periodic Table 2.2 Chem? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Microorganisms 2.0 Matter and Chemical Reactions 2.1 The Periodic Table 2.2 Chem.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Microorganisms 2.0 Matter and Chemical Reactions 2.1 The Periodic Table 2.2 Chem.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Microorganisms 2.0 Matter and Chemical Reactions 2.1 The Periodic Table 2.2 Chem.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Microorganisms 2.0 Matter and Chemical Reactions 2.1 The Periodic Table 2.2 Chem.

14. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Transport in plants ● Absorption of Water and Mineral Salts ● Translocation ● Fa? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Transport in plants ● Absorption of Water and Mineral Salts ● Translocation ● Fa.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Transport in plants ● Absorption of Water and Mineral Salts ● Translocation ● Fa.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Transport in plants ● Absorption of Water and Mineral Salts ● Translocation ● Fa.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Transport in plants ● Absorption of Water and Mineral Salts ● Translocation ● Fa.

15. Which practice best shows correct science when studying The Periodic Table 2.2 Chemical Families 2.3 Chemical Bonding 2.4 Acids, Bases a? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about The Periodic Table 2.2 Chemical Families 2.3 Chemical Bonding 2.4 Acids, Bases a.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on The Periodic Table 2.2 Chemical Families 2.3 Chemical Bonding 2.4 Acids, Bases a.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for The Periodic Table 2.2 Chemical Families 2.3 Chemical Bonding 2.4 Acids, Bases a.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to The Periodic Table 2.2 Chemical Families 2.3 Chemical Bonding 2.4 Acids, Bases a.

16. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Plant growth and development ● Concept of growth and development in plants ● See? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Plant growth and development ● Concept of growth and development in plants ● See.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Plant growth and development ● Concept of growth and development in plants ● See.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Plant growth and development ● Concept of growth and development in plants ● See.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Plant growth and development ● Concept of growth and development in plants ● See.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain Respiration ● Aerobic and anaerobic respiration ● Respiratory substrates and res and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Plant Growth and Development 1.7 Microorganisms 2.0 Matter and Chemical Reaction and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Plant growth and development ● Concept of growth and development in plants ● See and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Microorganisms 2.0 Matter and Chemical Reactions 2.1 The Periodic Table 2.2 Chem and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Microorganisms ● Types of microorganisms ● Mode of transmission and infections o and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

22. In three clear sentences, explain The Periodic Table 2.2 Chemical Families 2.3 Chemical Bonding 2.4 Acids, Bases a and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
